ruleDefinitions.name: Security Software Discovery - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of system utilities (only grep and egrep for now) to discover security software discovery

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/grep$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/egrep$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*nessusd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*td\\-agent.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*packetbeat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*filebeat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*auditbeat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*osqueryd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cbagentd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*falcond.*")))
